author: synced_reader plan, Task 9 (Entry points + bidirectional seek)
summary: Wired Task 7's useChapterTiming/useReaderSync and Task 8's ReaderView/ReaderContainer into two Book-tab entry points (embedded card in the Chapter Workspace + a standalone full-page route), plus click-to-seek on the reader's own focal block (no existing per-segment/group list lives in the Book tab outside the chapter editor, which is out of scope for this whole plan).

changes.change: NEW — buildChapterAudioUrl(chapter), the single shared expression for a chapter's own rendered-audio asset URL. Extracted so ChapterTable.tsx's play button and the reader's useReaderSync gate can never drift apart (previously two independent inline string templates).

MODIFIED — replaced the inline audioUrl template expression with buildChapterAudioUrl(chapter) (no behavior change; existing ChapterTable.test.tsx assertions on the constructed URL still pass unchanged).

NEW — shared hook wiring useChapterTiming + the global playerBus + useReaderSync + a lightweight local api.fetchSegments(chapterId) fetch (mirrors BoothTool's own fetch-segments-locally pattern; not the heavy useChapterEditor/useStudioChapter chain, which is ChapterEditor-owned) into segmentTextById and the props ReaderContainer/ReaderView need. Also owns the click-to-seek handler (onActiveBlockClick -> playerBus.seek(activeGroup.start_ms / 1000)) so the bus position stays the single source of truth. Used by both entry points below so they can't diverge.

MODIFIED (Task 8 file) — added an optional onActiveBlockClick prop wired onto the active block's onClick (both the reduced-motion and Framer Motion variants), with a pointer cursor only when the handler is supplied. Omitting it preserves the exact prior (non-interactive) behavior; ReaderView still never seeks itself, it only reports the click.

MODIFIED (Task 8 file) — added an optional startExpanded prop (default false, preserving the existing 'starts embedded' behavior) that mounts directly into the 'expanded' full-browser-overlay display state. Used by the standalone ReaderPage route so a dedicated full-page route doesn't show a small 320px embedded card floating alone on an otherwise-blank page — it reuses the existing overlay chrome (close/fullscreen controls) rather than adding a fourth display state.

NEW — the embedded entry point (ReaderContainer display state 1) mounted in the Chapter Workspace (BookLayout.tsx's ChapterWorkspace, near ChapterWorkspaceHeader — NOT inside DirectorsConsole/Booth, which is frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/ and out of scope for this plan). Also renders the 'Open Full Reader' link/button to the standalone route.

NEW — standalone full-page reader route component. Fetches its own chapter via api.fetchChapter (no BookDataProvider — intentionally lightweight/standalone) and reuses useChapterReaderSync, rendering ReaderContainer with startExpanded.
MODIFIED — ChapterWorkspace now renders <ChapterReaderCard bookId chapter /> right after ChapterWorkspaceHeader (guarded on chapter being resolved), before the DirectorsConsole/Lexicon flex row.
MODIFIED — added the lazy-loaded ReaderPage route at /book/:bookId/chapter/:chapterId/reader, alongside the existing /book/:bookId/chapter/:chapterId route.
NEW — pins buildChapterAudioUrl's exact output shape and its null-when-no-audio case.

NEW — chapterAudioUrl matches buildChapterAudioUrl; isTrackingThisChapter gates true once the bus plays that exact URL; onActiveBlockClick calls the (mocked) playerBus.seek with activeGroup.start_ms / 1000 seconds; no-op when there's no active group.

NEW — renders the embedded card; idle when the bus isn't playing this chapter; tracks this chapter once the bus plays the exact same URL ChapterTable's own play button would construct; 'Open Full Reader' navigates to the standalone route.
NEW — fetches the chapter and renders ReaderContainer starting in the expanded display state; renders a back-to-chapter control.

MODIFIED — added one test asserting the embedded read-along reader card ('Read along' region) renders in the chapter workspace; existing tests/mocks in this file were left as-is (ChapterReaderCard's own segment fetch is caught/no-ops gracefully against this file's api mock, which does not define fetchSegments).
MODIFIED (Task 8 file) — added onActiveBlockClick coverage (called on click; no-op/no-throw when omitted).

invariants: The reader still never seeks itself — playerBus.seek(...) is the only mutation onActiveBlockClick performs; all reader state remains a pure function of playerBus.position via useReaderSync. chapterAudioUrl construction now has exactly one implementation (buildChapterAudioUrl), shared by ChapterTable's play button and the reader's gate, so they cannot silently drift again. frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/ was not touched by this task.
note: Task 9 of design-docs/plans/active/synced_reader/ (04-roadmap.md) — closes out the plan's frontend track. No existing segment/group list lives in the Book tab outside the chapter editor (CastPalette/BoothTool are ChapterEditor-owned), so bidirectional seek uses 03-reader-frontend.md's explicitly-allowed fallback: the reader's own focal block is the click-to-seek surface, not a new segment-list UI.
